tasks.title: Add a standard-library control-plane validator and status command
acceptance: python project_control.py validate
python project_control.py status
python project_control.py self-test
stop_conditions: Do not modify main or repository security settings

tasks.title: Add control-plane validation to the active deterministic CI
acceptance: The active CI invokes the validator
A malformed-state negative test fails
stop_conditions: Do not replace or merge an unrelated CI workflow without diff review

tasks.title: Audit active v0.1 implementation against the roadmap and create evidence-backed task contracts
acceptance: Every E-001 through E-011 workstream has a current status and evidence boundary grounded in source/docs
REPORT.md no longer points to stale in-progress runs or obsolete test counts
Historical raw traces and dispatch request artifacts remain immutable and are clearly distinguished from active manifests
Runtime, service syntax, persistence, transport, production identity, capacity, and model acceptance are not overstated
Each v0.1 gap is mapped to M1-M5 and independently verifiable follow-up work
expected_outputs: Reconciled REPORT.md and experiment status notes
Updated task graph for M1/M2 and remaining M0 gates
stop_conditions: Do not claim model success or runtime selection without evidence

tasks.title: Audit reboot-core CI baseline and the staging fast-CI candidate
acceptance: Reboot-core base revision is pinned and its associated workflow runs are inventoried
The staging CI branch is compared without merging its divergent history
Candidate CI risks and a safe port sequence are recorded
stop_conditions: Do not merge the stale staging branch wholesale
Do not weaken required security or integration tests

tasks.title: Establish evidence ledger and automated claims checks
acceptance: Completion claims must reference one or more unique RUN_LEDGER event IDs
Referenced events must have an eligible success outcome and immutable run/commit/URL evidence
Duplicate event IDs, malformed ledger lines, unknown references, failed outcomes, mutable source URLs, and path-only evidence are rejected
Negative unit tests cover every rejection class
Claims checker runs in the project-control fast-CI precheck
Each verified milestone exit criterion maps to exactly one evidence-backed completion claim
Every verified milestone exit criterion maps to exactly one evidence-backed completion claim
stop_conditions: Never synthesize run IDs, hashes, or benchmark metrics

tasks.title: Port and test the path-aware fast runner on reboot-core
acceptance: Deleted source/test paths select the affected suite
Project-control changes select the validator/self-test suite
Path selection and cross-suite dependencies have unit tests
All selected deterministic suites pass on the reboot-core base
stop_conditions: Do not port the divergent branch history
Do not claim staging timings as reboot-core measurements

tasks.title: Consolidate workflow policy without losing manual and extended checks
acceptance: All 15 legacy workflow responsibilities are mapped
Unified L0/L1/L2 triggers and least-privilege permissions are reviewed
Layer 0 and Layer 1 pass in one workflow run on the PR head (run 44424340406)
E-002 ten-repetition benchmark and E-009 ten-run confirmation are manual-only
CPU-only model runs are explicitly non-acceptance diagnostics
No workflow concurrency groups can cancel in-flight evidence
E-009 PR smoke is labelled as a product-path smoke, not a capacity claim
After PR #64 is integrated, PR #65 is retargeted to research/reboot-core and passes a fresh run
Always-on E-009 smoke enforces functional expectations only; capacity thresholds remain in the manual ten-repetition confirmation
Run 44428892897 and run 44429525898 both pass Layer 0 and Layer 1 after the E-009 smoke threshold separation
expected_outputs: Fresh full run after retargeting PR #65 to research/reboot-core following PR #64 integration
stop_conditions: Do not weaken trust-boundary tests
Do not enable unattended paid model runs
evidence_ids: E-009 smoke zero failed expectations without capacity enforcement

tasks.title: Create an installable agent_native package without selecting a production runtime
acceptance: pip install . succeeds in a clean isolated environment without network runtime dependencies
Public imports are exposed from agent_native
Package metadata and supported Python version are explicit
No production runtime or language selection is claimed
stop_conditions: Do not silently change service syntax or runtime semantics
Do not introduce nonessential runtime dependencies

tasks.title: Remove import-time sys.path mutation from the packaged core and entry points
acceptance: No import-time sys.path.insert or sys.path mutation remains in supported package/CLI paths
Internal imports resolve through the package namespace
Legacy research prototypes are either migrated or explicitly isolated as non-package experiments
Import tests pass from outside the repository root
stop_conditions: Do not break reproducible historical experiment entry points without a migration path

tasks.title: Add a unified developer CLI for check, run, inspect, worker, and audit
acceptance: One installed command exposes check, run, inspect, worker, and audit subcommands
Each command has deterministic help, exit codes, and machine-readable errors
CLI commands operate on explicit service IDs/paths and never infer production credentials
CLI smoke tests run from a clean installed environment
stop_conditions: Do not add production deployment commands in M1

tasks.title: Preserve deterministic regression coverage through package migration
acceptance: Existing deterministic suite count is not reduced without an evidence-backed replacement
Package install, import isolation, CLI, parser/IR, Gateway, HTTP, persistence, and audit tests pass
CI runs the packaged test suite from the installed artifact
Coverage claims are generated from actual test output, not hand-maintained counts
stop_conditions: Do not weaken trust-boundary or failure-injection tests

tasks.title: Load services through a manifest-backed ServiceRegistry
acceptance: Service IDs resolve through an explicit manifest/registry rather than hard-coded Catalog mappings
Service source, version, handlers, and policy references are validated before publication
Unknown or duplicate service IDs fail closed
A second service loads without editing kernel/Gateway code
stop_conditions: Do not add dynamic code execution or arbitrary plugin imports as a loading mechanism

tasks.title: Drive declarative CRUD, job, and event handlers from service IR
acceptance: GET/list/create/update/delete/job/event handler contracts are represented declaratively
Handler dispatch is generic and does not branch on service or operation names
Input/output/error schemas and effect declarations are validated against IR
Custom handlers require explicit trusted host registration
stop_conditions: Do not allow agent-supplied Python or arbitrary handler code

tasks.title: Generalize Agent Gateway proposals to explicit read/write effects while keeping apply separate
acceptance: Gateway resolves any registered service by service ID
Read and write proposal effects have explicit capability mapping and default-deny policy
Agent may propose, validate, and plan write operations but cannot invoke service.apply
Trust-boundary negative tests cover missing grants, cross-tenant scope, unsupported effects, and service identity mismatch
stop_conditions: Do not grant agent-writer service.apply authority
Trust-boundary changes require two independent reviews and a new security regression test

tasks.title: Prove a second service can be added without changing core code
acceptance: A second service is added using only manifest, IR, declarative handlers, and policy configuration
No core runtime/Gateway source changes are required for that service
Read and write proposal/validate/plan flows are tested against the second service
Cross-tenant and unauthorized-write negative tests pass
stop_conditions: Do not treat a fixture-only demonstration as production readiness
